contentNotice: Fictional public information portal. Illustrative records and local demo actions are labelled.

history.title: First Gate
history.summary: The first confirmed dimensional Gate appears in Seoul, South Korea; other Gates and the first generation of Hunters subsequently appear.

history.title: First Contact Era
history.summary: Governments investigate dimensional phenomena, Mana and monster biology amid destructive early Gate disasters.

history.title: Hunter Era
history.summary: Hunter licensing, guilds, professional exploration and standardized combat classifications emerge.

history.title: Mana Revolution
history.summary: Mana transforms power generation, manufacturing, medicine and specialized materials.

history.title: Corporate Ascendancy
history.summary: Megacorporations expand across energy, cybernetics, AI, biotechnology, finance and security.

history.title: Corporate Resource Wars
history.summary: Conflicts over Gate resources, technology, corporate interests and regional governments reshape the world.

history.title: Meridian Accords
history.summary: International agreements establish new systems for regulating Gates, Hunters and Mana resource trading.

history.title: Neon Age
history.summary: Cybernetic augmentation and advanced urban infrastructure become widespread.

history.title: Ascension Era
history.summary: Unusual dimensional phenomena and unexplained Gate patterns attract scientific attention. Gate origins remain unknown.

nationalDesignation: National-Level is a strategic designation for certain extraordinary S-Rank Hunters, not a universal rank above S.
rankRules: Rankings consider combat ability, Mana output, control and other relevant factors.
Rankings may be disputed, outdated or affected by unusual abilities; S-Rank Hunters are not equally powerful.
Hunters do not gain experience points by killing monsters.
Training improves technique, judgment, control, efficiency and mastery.
Second Awakenings are rare and unpredictable.

mana.description: Supernatural energy associated with dimensional phenomena.
mana.core: The Mana Core Complex is distributed physiological and supernatural organization, not necessarily a physical crystal.
rules: Abilities have limitations, energy costs and vulnerabilities.

cyberware.maintenance: Maintenance, software updates, medical procedures and calibration are required. Even high-quality systems may be dangerous when incompatible with a user.

cds.name: Cybernetic Dissociation Syndrome
cds.description: Neurological stress, cybernetic incompatibility, psychological destabilization and sometimes Mana feedback.

stages.name: Unstable
stages.description: Dissociation, paranoia, system failures, possible aggression.

stages.name: Critical
stages.description: Significant perceptual disturbances, dangerous feedback, possible violent outbursts.

stages.name: Cyberpsycho Breakdown
stages.description: Acute crisis with potentially uncontrolled cyberware or supernatural abilities.

cds.care: Treatment may include medical care, cyberware recalibration, surgery, Mana stabilization and rehabilitation.
cds.awareness: Violence is possible but not inevitable. Affected people do not inherently become evil or violent.

gates.definition: Dimensional interfaces connecting Earth to other environments.

terms.Gate Break: Containment failure or dimensional threats entering Earth.

rules: Gate classification is separate from Hunter rank and monster grade.
Not every Gate has a boss.
Killing the strongest monster does not automatically close a Gate.
Mechanisms and dimensional anchors may be unknown; research is ongoing.
The origin of Gates remains unknown.

ecology: Dimensional creatures have ecological relationships. Some may have intelligence, culture, language and political systems. Not all species are hostile; classifications may remain uncertain pending research.

economy.benchmarkNotice: Indicative MCR-equivalent monthly benchmarks, not universal fixed prices.
economy.hunterIncome: Varies enormously with contracts, risk, rank, insurance and guild arrangements.

governance: International cooperation coexists with independent national authorities, police, military units and laws. There is no single global government.
publicRecordPolicy: Official public records, professional press profiles, fan views and unverified rumors are distinct. No confidential medical information, hidden motives or private secrets are established here.
